newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seven killed in South Korean pile-up.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in South Korean pile-up.

text.p: Seven people were killed and some 25 injured on Thursday in a highway pile-up involving a bus, two trucks and three cars, police said.
The accident occured in the early hours of Thursday morning near the central city of Chonan on a highway linking Seoul with the southern city of Pusan.
Police said the bus was carrying about 28 people.
A police officer contacted by telephone in Chonan said the accident happened when a truck en route for Seoul hit another truck from behind.
"About 15 minutes after the collision, the bus hit one of those trucks left on the highway," he said.
